Given that, we likely won't be in a position to do a full purchasing discussion or accept contract paperwork until the week of Dec 6 at the earliest.

That said, the engineering team (Tom and I) would welcome a shorter 30–40 minute technical office hours session with your infra lead to validate a couple integration assumptions (tokenization behavior, KV cache persistence across batch jobs). If you can offer a brief hands-on sync this week or early next week that would be helpful — we can then plan a full integration demo after our planning gate clears.

Can you propose a 30-minute window for an engineer-focused session? Also, please send over any procurement docs we can pre-fill so our team is ready once approvals come through.

Jasmine / Marcus,

Good note from Kathy — sounds like a classic planning-gate delay rather than a loss. Two quick options:

- Option A: Offer a 30-minute engineer office hours (hands-on) this week (Thu/Fri) and reschedule the full 75-minute customer-facing integration demo to week of Dec 6 after the planning gate.
- Option B: Keep Nov 24 tentative for the full demo but block it as "tentative — subject to procurement sign-off" and proactively share the procurement packet + draft PO for Vertex to pre-fill.

Pros: Option A preserves momentum with the eng team and surfaces any technical blockers quickly. Option B reduces calendar churn for us but risks a last-minute cancellation and wasted prep.

Next steps I recommend: 1) Offer two immediate office-hours slots (Fri Nov 20 09:00 PT or Fri Nov 20 14:00 PT) and 2) send the PO template and MSA redline summary to Vertex procurement so they can pre-populate while their execs finalize budgets. Marcus — can you attach the PO template and MSA redline summary? I’ll be on the quick engineer call if needed.

Thanks,
Logan
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
